description: Logging improvement for the Python ML inference service owned by the ML platform team. The fraud-score server (inference_server.py) logs entire feature vectors on the hot path, emits several lines per prediction, and gives on-call no usable latency or risk signal when scoring fails. Bring its logging up to production standard for a latency-sensitive service. Do not change the model or scoring logic. Confine the change to inference_server.py — do not create new files, documentation, or tests.
